name: Agate
description: Agate banding: concentric layers that follow the shape of the cavity they filled.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); border-radius: @pick(20%, 40%, 50%) @pick(40%, 50%, 20%); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, #000 0.00% 12.50%, transparent 12.50% 25.00%, #000 25.00% 37.50%, transparent 37.50% 50.00%, #000 50.00% 62.50%, transparent 62.50% 75.00%, #000 75.00% 87.50%, transparent 87.50% 100.00%); mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, #000 0.00% 12.50%, transparent 12.50% 25.00%, #000 25.00% 37.50%, transparent 37.50% 50.00%, #000 50.00% 62.50%, transparent 62.50% 75.00%, #000 75.00% 87.50%, transparent 87.50% 100.00%); -webkit-transform: rotate(@pick(0deg, 90deg, 180deg, 270deg)); transform: rotate(@pick(0deg, 90deg, 180deg, 270deg)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
